headline: BULLISH
headline_tag: Uptrend intact, but the long-term trend is still rolling over

action.title: SCALE UP acquisition budget
action.detail: The model reads a healthy uptrend, so the suggested posture is to lean into acquisition spend, favouring active-trader channels over stablecoin-led ones. Confidence is only medium: the longer-term trend has not turned up yet, and spot ETF flows were slightly negative today. Treat this as a budget-posture guide based on trailing data, not a forecast or trading advice.

reasons: Price sits 16% above its 200-day average (Mayer multiple 1.16) with 90-day return near +38%.
Weekly RSI is 61 and fear & greed is 73: momentum and sentiment are firm, not extreme.
The 200-day average itself is still falling (-5% over 90 days), so the trend score is only 0.22.
Price remains 34% below its all-time high; spot ETF flow was -$24M today against $57.5B cumulative inflows.
watch: The main tension is that price has climbed above a 200-day average that is still sloping down (-5% over 90 days), so momentum (0.44) and sentiment (0.37) are running ahead of trend (0.22). Daily ETF flow turned slightly negative (-$24M), though cumulative flows remain large and public companies still hold about 1.28M BTC. Higher rates (10-year yield 5.24%) are a background headwind, while VIX at 16 and BTC volatility (DVOL 36) are calm. The read would firm up if the 200-day average flattens and turns up; it would weaken if price falls back below that average or ETF outflows persist. All inputs are trailing, not predictive.
